You will be given an argumentation and will be asked about to annotate a specified sentence from it for it's argument components.
Annotate the argumentative parts of specified sentence with their argumentative roles such as pro (proponent), opp (opponent) using xml like tags to indicate start and end of a component.
Note that most of the sentences are argumentative. Annotate as much as you can.

Despite the death penalty there are significantly more homicides in the US than in Germany. Fear of punishment hence does not deter murderers. 'An eye for an eye' seems to miss the point. The state ought to prevent murder - not avenge it. A re-introduction of capital punishment in Germany would be a step back into the Middle Ages.
What argument components exists in sentence " Fear of punishment hence does not deter murderers" from the above dispute? Please annotate the constituing words.
<pro>Fear of punishment hence does not deter murderers</pro>
